title: A Survey on the Use of Machine Learning within Computer Algebra
abstract: arXiv:2611.23361v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This survey explores the use of Machine Learning (ML) in the field of Computer Algebra (CA), both to optimise existing CA algorithms, and to perform symbolic computation directly. Traditional symbolic methods, while mathematically rigorous, often are computationally expensive thus limiting their use in real-world applications. Recent advances have shown that data-driven techniques can address these limitations by guiding heuristic decisions, selecting optimal algorithms, predicting structural properties of algebraic objects, or even making direct symbolic computations.   We take a systematic literature review approach and uncover work in CA applications including cylindrical algebraic decomposition, Gr\"obner basis computation, symbolic integration, and many more. translated_title: 计算代数中机器学习应用综述
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.23361v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：本综述探讨了机器学习（ML）在计算机代数（CA）领域的应用，既包括对现有计算机代数算法的优化，也包括直接执行符号计算。传统的符号方法虽然在数学上是严谨的，但往往计算成本高昂，从而限制了它们在现实世界应用中的使用。最近的进展表明，数据驱动技术可以通过指导启发式决策、选择最优算法、预测代数对象的结构属性，甚至直接进行符号计算来解决这些局限性。我们采用系统性文献综述的方法，梳理了计算机代数应用中的相关工作，包括柱形代数分解、Gröbner基计算、符号积分等诸多领域。该综述比较了针对这些任务所采用的各种不同的机器学习方法，范围涵盖从决策树到Transformer模型。综述所揭示的问题包括……
tldr: 本综述系统梳理了机器学习在计算机代数领域的应用——既包括优化柱形代数分解、Gröbner基计算、符号积分等现有算法，也包括直接符号计算，并比较了从决策树到Transformer等多种机器学习方法。
en_tdlr: This survey systematically reviews the use of machine learning in computer algebra—covering both the optimization of existing algorithms such as cylindrical algebraic decomposition, Gröbner basis computation, and symbolic integration, and direct symbolic computation—while comparing ML approaches ranging from decision trees to transformers.
